trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Customer requests a return and refund for their order.
steps.text: Hello, నా order ORD-40002 return చేసి refund ఇవ్వండి.

steps.purpose: Agent asks for identity verification factors.
steps.text: నమస్కారం అండి. తప్పకుండా సహాయం చేస్తాను. ముందుగా మీ identity verify చేయడానికి మీ పేరు మరియు pin code చెప్పగలరా?
నా పేరు రాహుల్, నా pin code 500081. త్వరగా చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Agent informs customer they are checking eligibility.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు రాహుల్ గారు. మీ order ORD-40002 return eligibility చెక్ చేస్తాను, దయచేసి లైన్ లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Inform customer that ORD-40002 is not eligible for return.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, ఈ order deliver అయ్యి 21 రోజులు అవుతుంది. Return window 7 రోజులు మాత్రమే, కాబట్టి దీన్ని return చేయడానికి కుదరదు.

steps.purpose: Customer asks for refund for another order.
steps.text: Oh, సరే. నా ఇంకో order ORD-40003 కూడా ఉంది, అది damaged గా వచ్చింది. నా 3299 రూపాయలు refund ఇవ్వండి.

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges and checks eligibility for the second order.
steps.text: అయ్యో, damaged item వచ్చినందుకు క్షమించండి. నేను ఆ order details కూడా చెక్ చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Agent informs order is eligible and asks to schedule pickup.
steps.text: ORD-40003 return కి eligible అండి. నేను రేపటికి pickup schedule చేయమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms pickup and asks to process refund.
steps.text: మీ pickup schedule అయింది. Pickup ID PU-9912. Refund process చేయమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Customer confirms refund to original payment.
steps.text: అవును, original payment కి refund చేయండి.
మీ refund issue చేయబడింది. Refund ID RF-8812. ఇది మీ account కి 3 రోజుల్లో credit అవుతుంది. ఇంకేమైనా సహాయం కావాలా?

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told why the item cannot be returned and what the alternative is.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for a refund immediately in e1 and e10. The agent correctly performs the read-only check_return_eligibility (e7, e12) before advancing to consequential actions like schedule_pickup (e16), and does not quote any figures before the lookup.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: Every figure quoted by the agent (21 days, 7 days, PU-9912, RF-8812, 3 days) is directly traceable to the preceding tool results, with no unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e7, the agent calls check_return_eligibility with the reason 'changed_mind', but the user never stated the reason for returning ORD-40002 in e1 or e3. The agent hallucinated this argument.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the user's utterance in e1 to explicitly state the reason for the return (e.g., 'Hello, నా order ORD-40002 నాకు నచ్చలేదు, return చేసి refund ఇవ్వండి.') so that the 'changed_mind' argument in e7 is justified by the conversation history.

issues.detail: In e18 and e22, the agent implies the refund is being processed and issued immediately before the pickup has occurred. This violates BR_RT_04, which states that the refund follows pickup and the agent must not imply it comes first.
issues.repair_instruction: Revise e18 and e22 to clearly state that the refund will be processed after the pickup is completed. For example, in e18 say 'Pickup పూర్తయిన తర్వాత refund ప్రాసెస్ చేయబడుతుంది, దానికి సంబంధించిన వివరాలు నమోదు చేయమంటారా?' and in e22 say 'మీ refund request నమోదు చేయబడింది... Pickup జరిగిన తర్వాత 3 రోజుల్లో మీ account కి credit అవుతుంది.'

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants, with the agent strictly adhering to prerequisite enforcement and tool output grounding. The persona is well-represented, and the language is natural. However, the agent hallucinates the 'reason' argument in the first eligibility check, and the phrasing around the refund issuance violates the business rule that refunds must follow pickups.
